title: Leaked GTA 6 Motel Mission Details Reveal New Mechanics

lines.text: Leaked mission details for GTA 6 just surfaced online.
lines.label: LEAKED GTA 6 MISSION

lines.text: According to leaked walkthrough reports, an early Chapter Two mission is named 'Got Pills?'.
lines.label: CHAPTER 2 MISSION

lines.text: The story allegedly kicks off right after Jason gets injured in Vice City.
lines.label: JASON GETS INJURED
lines.subject: Jason And Lucia Motel

lines.text: You take control of Lucia at the run-down Starlet Motel.
lines.label: STARLET MOTEL
lines.subject: Lucia Caminos

lines.text: Her main objective sounds simple: track down painkillers to save Jason.
lines.label: FIND PAINKILLERS
lines.ai_prompt: first person view of pills bottle on a messy motel nightstand

lines.text: First, players must interrogate a motel resident named Zach outside Room 01.
lines.label: INTERROGATE ZACH
lines.subject: Jason And Lucia Motel

lines.text: Leaked controls show you hold aim and press a dialogue prompt to question him.
lines.label: HOLD LT TO TALK

lines.text: But while exploring, Lucia can even stop and pet dynamic stray animals.
lines.label: PET STRAY CATS
lines.ai_prompt: stray cat sitting on sunny concrete pavement next to motel door

lines.text: Zach directs you straight to room ten, marked with colorful stickers.
lines.label: ROOM 10

lines.text: But inside isn't medicine—it is a companion named Vicki.
lines.label: MEET VICKI

lines.text: Knocking on her door seamlessly triggers the next mission called 'Girls' Trip'.
lines.label: SEAMLESS TRANSITION

quote.text: Knocking on Vicki's door starts Girls' Trip.

lines.text: GTA Boom revealed eight full Chapter Two mission names in total.
lines.label: 8 MISSIONS LEAKED

lines.text: Rockstar hasn't confirmed these storylines, so treat them as unverified leaks.
lines.label: NOT OFFICIALLY CONFIRMED

lines.text: Does this motel mission sound like classic Rockstar storytelling?
lines.label: CLASSIC ROCKSTAR?
lines.subject: Cover Art

description: Unverified leaked walkthroughs for GTA 6 reveal an early mission titled Got Pills featuring Lucia at the Starlet Motel. The report highlights RDR2-style interactions, petting stray animals, and seamless mission chains.
